title: Basic Data Types and Operations
description: Explore CQL's primitive data types: Booleans, Strings, Integers, Decimals, Dates, and Quantities. Write defines that produce each type and learn how null and Coalesce work.
learningObjectives: Write Boolean expressions with and / or
Handle null with is null and Coalesce

hints.message: Boolean operators are and, or, not. 'true or false' evaluates to true.
Strings use single quotes in CQL and compare with = for exact equality.
10 / 3 is Integer division. Make one operand a Decimal literal: 10.0 / 3.0.
Add a calendar duration quantity to Today(): Today() + 30 days.
Quantity literals look like 175 'cm' — number, space, quoted UCUM unit.
Coalesce(null, 'Default Value') returns the first non-null argument.
